summary: Tested 4 P0 fixes in CoachPlay.jsx. All issues verified as FIXED: Issue 4 (Setup UI) - Time Control and Coaching Style selectors removed, only Color Selection, Coach Remembers, and Start Game button present. No 'Lvl X' badge in coach info bar. Issue 1 (State sync) - 'Analyzing your move...' indicator appears immediately after user makes a move, old feedback cleared. Issue 3 (Opening teaching) - Opening suggestion card has move count check (< 14) in rendering condition. Issue 2 (Fork detection) - Backend uses BB_KNIGHT_ATTACKS bitboard for precise knight-only attack detection.
critical_code_review_comments: Issue 4 VERIFIED: Setup screen (lines 2230-2270) only shows Color Selection, Coach Remembers, and Start Game button. No Time Control or Coaching Style selectors.
Issue 4 VERIFIED: Coach info bar (lines 2393-2400) shows 'Coach' with clock badge only, no 'Lvl X' badge.
Issue 1 VERIFIED: executeMove (lines 1348-1360) immediately clears v5Coaching, interactiveCoaching, behavioralCoaching, currentInsight and sets isCoachThinking=true.
Issue 1 VERIFIED: Coach thinking indicator (lines 2930-2940) shows 'Analyzing your move...' with spinner until feedback arrives.
Issue 3 VERIFIED: Opening suggestion card rendering (line 2787) includes condition (session?.move_history?.length || 0) < 14.
Issue 3 VERIFIED: useEffect (lines 530-537) auto-dismisses inlineOpening/inlineTrap when moves.length >= 14.
Issue 2 VERIFIED: detect_fork_in_pv (lines 448-505) uses chess.BB_KNIGHT_ATTACKS[knight_dest] instead of is_attacked_by() for precise knight-only detection.
Issue 2 VERIFIED: Fork threshold raised to 6 (requires rook+bishop or queen+anything value).
